decision.msg: One rule lives in a new class Servex/Landed.js (fold through Task.replay; legacy landed_at+outcome only if replay throws); task_landed() delegates to it. Alternative: edit task_landed in place and import Agents.js everywhere; rejected for import cycles and because Budget/Worktrees/Lifecycle/Asks/Cards could not import the 2000-line Agents.js cheaply.

Budgets stay advisory for an agent's own work (owner 2026-10-08). The spend refusal applies only to Servex-initiated wakes (servex-heartbeat, servex-compact-nudge): refused when spent + last turn cost passes the brief's Budget $N, else ceiling_usd(). Alternative: gate on ceiling_usd() ($100) alone; rejected because a $4 helper would never be refused.

A person's message, wake_parent and send_to_agent revive:true are not blocked for a landed live agent (only the watchdogs are): blocking the owner from talking to a landed agent was not asked for. A landed agent that ends a turn goes dormant, so nothing wakes it by itself.

log.msg: landed-from-landed_at sites routed through Landed (before -> after): Agents.task_landed (assign landed_at+outcome | closed_by -> Task.replay complete|stopped); Heartbeat.read done (same old expression -> Landed.of_file); Budget.sweep skip (same -> Landed.of_file); Worktrees.tasks landed (same -> Landed.of_dir); Lifecycle.task landed (landed_at+outcome -> Landed.of_dir); Asks.task_state landed (landed_at+outcome -> Landed.of_dir); asks/tasks.js facts.landed (any landed_at -> Landed.of_dir); Cards.ask_tip status (any assign.landed_at -> also Landed.of_dir). TaskLoop already used Task.replay. Left as data, not decisions: Budget.read_task landed_at copy, tasks.js facts.landed_at date.

Test: node Servex/Heartbeat-landed.test.mjs passes in worktree and on main: finish, complete, assign.landed_at without outcome, closed_by, stop all land; a planted finish task gets no status check and one 'heartbeat: skipped, landed' line over three ticks; an over-budget agent gets none and one 'refused' line; a planted $4 helper at $0.70 a wake is woken five times (spent $3.50) and the sixth is refused; task_landed true for all six real helper dirs (bubbles-anchor, sheet-double-mount, sheet-handoff-proof, dictate-wide, readme-trim, layout-check-path), where the old rule said false for all six. Private Servex booted from the worktree on :18090 (SERVEX_HOME tmp, SERVEX_PROXY_PORT 18080) and answered /api/agents; live Servex untouched. Pre-existing failure, same on main: awaken-race.test.mjs (TaskLoop.post_card is not a function).
Merged as e6d593c0e on michael/dev with --no-review (self-reviewed; the gate cannot see this 2026-10-13 task dir). Servex needs a restart (sustain.mjs --restart) to pick it up: the mastermind's step.

assign.outcome: One rule for landed (Servex/Landed.js via Task.replay); heartbeat, compact nudge never wake a landed or over-budget agent; merged e6d593c0e; Servex needs a restart.
